# fptcloud_snapshot (Resource)

Snapshots every volume attached to an instance at a point in time. The snapshot is crash-consistent: the disks are captured as they are, without quiescing the guest filesystem. A snapshot cannot be renamed, so changing any argument replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Each resource is one snapshot. To keep several, declare several: editing an
# argument does not add a snapshot, it replaces the one this resource owns.
# To retake a snapshot without changing anything:
#   terraform apply -replace='fptcloud_snapshot.before_upgrade'
resource "fptcloud_snapshot" "instance_snapshot" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  instance_id = fptcloud_instance.server.id
  name        = "instance_snapshot"

  # Optional.
  tag_ids     = ["your_tag_id"]
  include_ram = false
}

output "snapshot_id" {
  value = fptcloud_snapshot.instance_snapshot.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Id of the instance to snapshot
- `vpc_id` (String) Id of the vpc the instance belongs to

### Optional

- `include_ram` (Boolean) Capture the guest's memory alongside its disks, where the platform supports it
- `name` (String) Name for the snapshot, unique within the vpc. Up to 30 characters of letters, digits, underscores, dashes, dots and spaces. Left unset, the platform names it
- `tag_ids` (Set of String) Tag ids to apply to the snapshot, applied when it is created

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the snapshot was taken
- `created_by` (String) User that created the snapshot
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `infra_snapshot_id` (String) Id of the snapshot on the underlying infrastructure
- `size_gb` (Number) Total size of the snapshot, in GB
- `snapshot_type` (String) Type of the snapshot, as the platform reports it
- `status` (String) Current status of the snapshot, as the platform reports it
- `tags` (List of Object) Tags currently attached to the snapshot (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Snapshots are scoped to a vpc, so the vpc id is part of the import id.
terraform import fptcloud_snapshot.instance_snapshot vpc/your_vpc_id/snapshot/your_snapshot_id
```
